_comment: Copy this file to config.json (or point ARTEX_CONFIG at another path). It carries only the database and skill_dir sections; everything else (LLM profiles and so on) lives in environment variables or in the in-app settings.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > this file's database section. Pick one of two shapes: (A) fill in the individual fields below, or (B) put a complete DSN in database.dsn. See the per-field comments.
_comment_database_dsn: Shape (B): delete database above and put a complete DSN here instead. When dsn is non-empty the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Root directory of the skills (each subdirectory is one skill and contains SKILL.md). Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave it empty or remove it to use the default.
_comment_language: Default language for user-facing output (one of en or es). Agent-generated reports, summaries and chat replies, and the backend messages, follow this language. Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_LANG > this field > default (en).
